limits: This increment has no C Cluster transport, automatic MOVED/ASK execution, refresh, retries, cross-slot command planning or resharding/failover acceptance.
Real fixture is a disposable owned 3-master Redis8.0.5 plaintext IPv4 Cluster hosted in WSL. Hostname/unknown endpoints and real MOVED/ASK replies are projected, not dialed by C.
Native Linux, realistic mixed/fixed-arrival workloads, CPU/RSS/upstream comparison and >=72h production acceptance remain open.
Local benchmark uses one node/full slot range, sequential hot slot lookups and a fixed 9-byte hash tag. Reported ns are bulk means, not latency quantiles or production tails.
Legacy CRC comparison is the same new component/benchmark with the pre-change private bit loop; the Cluster API did not exist in the base revision.
